CCI empowered to adjudicate matter. Proceedings stands concluded and, if any, to be commenced afresh by CCI & as on date no comm. received from CCI 8.Some Licensees invoked arbitration for compensation of diff. rates of regular & combo meal provided under CCs by IR & claimed price of welcome drink from 2014 till date. Arbitrator awarded Rs. 7471.65 L (approx.) in 13 petitions from Jan. 15 to Mar. 20. On record claimant never claimed said amt while invoices for services. Services provided to passengers of IR & amt. so paid req. to be reimbursed to IRCTC by IR. In this case, no liability of IRCTC as consequence of award & no need to make prov. pursuant to awards Co. filed objection & Hon’ble HC, Delhi directed Co. to deposit amount to stay execution of Arbitral Award. Deposited a BG of Rs. 8471.65 L .
